title: Trump and GOP midterm investments hint at defense strategy
text:
Republicans insist they are playing offense before November’s midterm elections, but the party’s biggest spenders are increasingly investing in deep-red states that President Donald Trump has never lost.

The Senate map is the best example of this, where recent expenditures in states such as Kansas and Iowa foretell a potentially tumultuous election for Republicans.
